purpose: Repository-controlled downstream evidence for AC-24. Browser capture evidence is stored separately in browser-sql-e2e-latest.json; this file records the persisted-state, PostgreSQL concurrency, durable outbox, worker-boundary, settlement, statement, and adjustment checks that cover the rest of the revenue path.

commands.name: downstream_revenue_path_matrix
asserted_business_state: PostgreSQL quote and authenticated claim race converged on one claimed attribution session and one active customer commercial binding.
Quote snapshot persisted the partner attribution binding, partner account, partner code, claim touchpoint, quote touchpoint, and excluded the raw cookie token.
PostgreSQL concurrent order attribution resolution returned the same order_attribution_results row for both writers and emitted one attribution.result.finalized outbox event.

Settlement E2E created one partner earning event, one active hold, generated/reused partner statements, released hold/reserve, closed statement, created payout account, instruction, dry-run execution, completion, reconciliation, and a green reconciliation pack.
Refund and dispute flow created refund_clawback, dispute_clawback, and reserve_release statement adjustments, blocked/released reserves correctly, and updated statement totals.
Partner statement lifecycle closed, reopened, and adjusted statements through authenticated admin/support paths without rewriting source earning history.

commands.name: payment_completed_worker_outbox_matrix
asserted_business_state: Payment completed webhook duplicate processing serializes and emits one payment.completed outbox event.
Completed order payment attempts append durable payment.completed partner earning work after the attempt exists.
Concurrent payment.completed partner earning workers claim the publication once and create one consumer receipt.
Policy failure leaves cash artifacts absent and retries instead of silently succeeding.
Retry exhaustion dead-letters the publication and creates a reconciliation-required outbox event.
Internal runner requires the dedicated settlement worker secret and remains excluded from public OpenAPI/browser clients.
Payment completed worker uses order amount and immutable order attribution data rather than mutable/tampered payment metadata.

commands.name: task_worker_boundary_matrix
asserted_business_state: Task-worker payment.completed partner earning job calls the internal backend runner with the configured batch limit and worker id.
Task-worker fails retryably when backend configuration is missing instead of treating work as successful.
Task-worker skip path is explicit when the payment completed partner earning worker is disabled.
Task contract and schedule register process_partner_earning_from_payment on the payments queue with the payments retry policy.
Backend client sends only the dedicated payment settlement worker secret and excludes the Telegram bot secret.

secret_and_pii_handling: No raw transfer token, cookie value, bearer token, customer email, or provider credential is stored in this evidence file. Commands use local development service URLs and safe test secrets only.
relationship_to_browser_evidence: browser-sql-e2e-latest.json proves canonical public browser capture through local Next, backend, Redis, and PostgreSQL. This downstream matrix proves the remaining claim, quote, order attribution, durable payment.completed outbox/worker boundary, earning, hold, statement, payout dry-run, refund, and dispute adjustment behavior.
